statement: The T026 candidate **shall** satisfy the deterministic Fabro gate for an implementation task: the six named work products exist, at least one `src/xverse/xcom/` path and at least one `tests/` path change, `cmake` configure, build, discovery, and the full `ctest` suite pass, and `git diff --check` is clean; the T026 checkbox is marked complete **only** in the implementation stage.
title: T026 requirement 022
